defmodule CrossAuth.DBDriver do
  @moduledoc """
  Database driver with cross-service authentication.
  Handles packet framing for the custom binary protocol.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @header_size 8
  @max_payload 16_777_215
  @auth_token_prefix <<0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC, 0xDD>>
  @protocol_version 3

  defstruct [:socket, :buffer, :auth_state, :service_id, :nonce]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def authenticate(service_id, credential) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:authenticate, service_id, credential})
  end

  def query(sql, params \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:query, sql, params})
  end

  # --- GenServer Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    host = Keyword.get(opts, :host, "127.0.0.1")
    port = Keyword.get(opts, :port, 5433)
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.connect(String.to_charlist(host), port, [
      :binary, active: false, packet: :raw
    ])
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{socket: socket, buffer: <<>>, auth_state: :disconnected}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:authenticate, service_id, credential}, _from, state) do
    nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
    auth_payload = build_auth_payload(service_id, credential, nonce)
    packet = frame_packet(0x01, auth_payload)
    :ok = :gen_tcp.send(state.socket, packet)

    case recv_response(state.socket) do
      {:ok, 0x01, response_data} ->
        if verify_auth_response(response_data, nonce) do
          {:reply, :ok, %{state | auth_state: :authenticated, service_id: service_id, nonce: nonce}}
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :auth_failed}, state}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:query, sql, params}, _from, %{auth_state: :authenticated} = state) do
    query_payload = encode_query(sql, params)
    packet = frame_packet(0x03, query_payload)
    :ok = :gen_tcp.send(state.socket, packet)

    case recv_response(state.socket) do
      {:ok, _type, data} -> {:reply, {:ok, decode_result(data)}, state}
      {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:query, _sql, _params}, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:error, :not_authenticated}, state}
  end

  # --- Packet Framing ---
  # Protocol: [version:1][type:1][length:4][checksum:2][payload:length]
  # length field is the payload size as unsigned 32-bit integer

  defp frame_packet(type, payload) do
    len = byte_size(payload)
    checksum = compute_checksum(payload)
    <<@protocol_version::8, type::8, len::unsigned-32, checksum::16, payload::binary>>
  end

  defp recv_response(socket) do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, @header_size, 5000) do
      {:ok, header} ->
        parse_and_recv_payload(socket, header)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp parse_and_recv_payload(socket, <<@protocol_version::8, type::8, length::unsigned-32, _checksum::16>>) do
    # Receive exactly 'length' bytes of payload
    recv_payload(socket, type, length)
  end

  defp parse_and_recv_payload(_socket, _header) do
    {:error, :invalid_protocol}
  end

  defp recv_payload(_socket, _type, 0) do
    {:ok, 0, <<>>}
  end

  defp recv_payload(socket, type, length) when length > 0 and length <= @max_payload do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, length, 5000) do
      {:ok, payload} -> {:ok, type, payload}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp recv_payload(_socket, _type, _length) do
    {:error, :invalid_length}
  end

  # --- Auth Helpers ---

  defp build_auth_payload(service_id, credential, nonce) do
    service_bytes = service_id |> to_string() |> pad_to(32)
    cred_hash = :crypto.hash(:sha256, credential)
    <<@auth_token_prefix::binary, service_bytes::binary, cred_hash::binary, nonce::binary>>
  end

  defp verify_auth_response(response_data, nonce) do
    expected_hmac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, nonce, "AUTH_OK")
    case response_data do
      <<0x00, hmac::binary-size(32), _rest::binary>> ->
        :crypto.hash_equals(expected_hmac, hmac)
      _ ->
        false
    end
  end

  # --- Query Encoding ---

  defp encode_query(sql, params) do
    param_count = length(params)
    encoded_params = Enum.map(params, &encode_param/1) |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
    sql_bytes = sql |> to_string()
    sql_len = byte_size(sql_bytes)
    <<sql_len::32, sql_bytes::binary, param_count::16, encoded_params::binary>>
  end

  defp encode_param(val) when is_integer(val), do: <<0x01, val::signed-64>>
  defp encode_param(val) when is_binary(val) do
    len = byte_size(val)
    <<0x02, len::32, val::binary>>
  end
  defp encode_param(nil), do: <<0x00>>
  defp encode_param(val) when is_float(val), do: <<0x03, val::float-64>>

  defp decode_result(data), do: data

  # --- Utilities ---

  defp compute_checksum(payload) do
    :erlang.crc32(payload) |> Bitwise.band(0xFFFF)
  end

  defp pad_to(binary, size) when byte_size(binary) >= size do
    :binary.part(binary, 0, size)
  end
  defp pad_to(binary, size) do
    pad_len = size - byte_size(binary)
    <<binary::binary, 0::size(pad_len * 8)>>
  end
end
